newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Aga sells 20,000 T white sugar to Somalia.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Aga sells 20,000 T white sugar to Somalia.

text.p: Consorcio Aga, a Jalisco state sugar-to-soft drinks company, has sold 20,000 tonnes of white sugar to the African nation Somalia, the trading manager of the company's sugar unit said Thursday.
"It is going to Somalia, there are 20,000 tonnes in total," Mario Garcia Vega, trading manager from the sugar mill Ingenio Puga told Reuters in a telephone interview.
"They are the first exports of the group and we believe it is only the beginning," he added.

Garcia Vega said 11,000 tonnes was ready to be shipped out of the Pacific port of Manzanillo in Sinaloa state and the 9,000 other tonnes would be sent on to Somalia at the latest on the final day of May.
"We are ready to send the rest when the boat returns for the second shipment," he added.
Ingenio Puga mill is in the western state of Nayarit and is owned by Aga. Aga has another mill in Sinaloa state.
